sources.summary: MSI's EdgeMesa N AI+ brings Nvidia RTX Spark N1X power to a Windows-on-Arm mini PC with 128GB of unified memory, strong local AI performance, and the ability to game on the side. But its high $7,499 price isn't that much cheaper than more versatile DGX Spark systems.
sources.summary_zh: 微星的 EdgeMes​​a N AI+ 为 Windows-on-Arm 迷你 PC 带来了 Nvidia RTX Spark N1X 的强大功能，具有 128GB 统一内存、强大的本地 AI 性能以及侧面游戏的能力。但其 7,499 美元的高价并不比功能更丰富的 DGX Spark 系统便宜多少。
